correctness.rationale: The 120 normalized vertices and 4 Coxeter-root reflections are exactly enumerated in Z[phi]. Group closure yields 14400 different symmetries and the icosahedral vertex-figure bound proves group completeness. The checker traverses every one of the 280840 unordered triples: 56 orbits and 56 pairwise distinct exact Gram signatures. Stabilizers are computed against the full group: all intrinsic triangle-label isometries lift except in the 2400-triple orthogonal class where only the cyclic 3 permutations lift. A separate signed-coordinate parity obstruction proves the missing transposition, and 8 fixed-vertex distance shells prove two-point homogeneity. A replay of the actual standalone checker succeeded. The finite exhaustive certificate covers the fixed 120-point set without extrapolation.

value.rationale: Addresses the point-homogeneity degree specifically flagged as unsettled in a 2022 paper for the exceptional regular 600-cell. The 56 intrinsic triangle congruence classes classify a natural complete geometric invariant for all 280840 vertex triples. A unique exceptional class, consisting of 2400 orthogonal triangles, precisely separates setwise from prescribed-label metric homogeneity; the structural C3-versus-S3 stabilizer obstruction is mathematically meaningful.
